+Family conventions: ../../kueue-pr-evidence-common/SKILL.md. Python 3 stdlib only.
+
+    red-green all --worktree DIR [--out-dir DIR]        # PR worktree = head; throwaway base tree
+    red-green all --pr <num|url> --repo-dir DIR [...]   # any PR (e.g. merged): throwaway base + head
+    red-green plan --repo-dir DIR --base SHA --head SHA [--with-test-support]
+    red-green run --plan P --base-tree B --head-tree H --out R [--base-runs 3]
+    red-green prow --results R [--pr N] [--out F] [--no-junit]
+    red-green render --results R [--prow F]             # block content on stdout (no markers)
+
+The base side is generated: only the PR's *_test.go + testdata hunks are applied onto a
+merge-base worktree. If they do not apply or compile, the verdict is "not applicable: tests
+depend on new code" and the unpatched base tests are run instead; a red result is never faked.
+This script never edits a PR body; publish the block with kueue-pr-evidence-common's inject-pr-notes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SKILL = "kueue-pr-evidence-red-green"
+DEFAULT_REPO = "kubernetes-sigs/kueue"
+MAX_VISIBLE = 24  # injector budget is 25 including its header line
+MAX_ROWS = 8
+BASE_RUNS = 3
+SUPPORT_PREFIXES = ("pkg/util/testing/", "pkg/util/testingjobs/", "test/util/")
+KUEUE_URL_RE = re.compile(r"github\.com[:/]kubernetes-sigs/kueue(\.git)?/?$")
+PR_URL_RE = re.compile(r"^https?://github\.com/([^/]+/[^/]+)/pull/(\d+)")
+HUNK_RE = re.compile(r"^@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@")
+FUNC_RE = re.compile(r"^func\s+(?:\([^)]*\)\s*)?(\w+)\s*\(")
+TEST_FUNC_RE = re.compile(r"^func\s+(Test\w*)\s*\(\s*\w+\s+\*testing\.T\s*\)")
+STR = r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"'
+CASE_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^\s+" + STR + r":\s*\{\s*$")
+CASE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?:name|desc|description):\s*" + STR + r",?\s*$")
+GINKGO_RE = re.compile(
+    r"\b(?:ginkgo\.)?(F?It|F?Describe|F?Context|F?When|F?DescribeTable|F?Entry|Specify)\(\s*" + STR)
+LEAF_NODES = {"It", "FIt", "Entry", "FEntry", "Specify"}
+GO_LOC_RE = re.compile(r"\S+\.go:\d+(?::\d+)?: ")
+INFRA_RE = re.compile(r"no space left on device|cannot allocate memory|signal: killed|"
+                      r"too many open files|dial tcp|i/o timeout|TLS handshake timeout|"
+                      r"connection reset by peer|resource temporarily unavailable")
+KLOG_RE = re.compile(r"^[IWEF]\d{4} \d")
+TEST_LOC_RE = re.compile(r"\w+_test\.go:\d+")
+# throwaway worktree prefix (…/kueue-pr-evidence/<root>worktrees/<sha.rand>/), kept out of PR bodies
+TREE_PATH_RE = re.compile(r"(?:/private)?/\S*?/[\w-]*pr-evidence/[\w.-]*worktrees/[\w.-]+/")
+FAIL_STATES = {"failed", "panicked", "interrupted", "timedout", "aborted"}
+ICON = {"red": "❌", "green": "✅", "warn": "⚠️"}
+
+
+class Fail(Exception):
+    """User-facing error; exit 2."""
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
+
+def sh(cmd: list[str], cwd: str | os.PathLike | None = None, check: bool = True,
+       env: dict | None = None, timeout: int | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+    res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=timeout)
+    if check and res.returncode != 0:
+        raise Fail(f"{shlex.join(cmd)} failed ({res.returncode}): {res.stderr.strip()[:500]}")
+    return res
+
+
+def git(repo: str | os.PathLike, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
+    return sh(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], check=check).stdout
+
+
+def short(sha: str) -> str:
+    return sha[:12]
+
+
+def go_unquote(s: str) -> str:
+    try:
+        return json.loads('"' + s + '"')
+    except ValueError:
+        return s
+
+
+def go_subtest_name(name: str) -> str:
+    """testing.rewrite: spaces become underscores (other printable runes are kept)."""
+    return "".join("_" if c.isspace() else c for c in name)
+
+
+def re2_escape(text: str) -> str:
+    """Escape for Go RE2 (it rejects escaped letters/spaces, so only escape metacharacters)."""
+    return re.sub(r"([\\.+*?()|\[\]{}^$])", r"\\\1", text)
+
+
+def indent_of(line: str) -> int:
+    n = 0
+    for c in line:
+        if c == "\t":
+            n += 4
+        elif c == " ":
+            n += 1
+        else:
+            break
+    return n
+
+
+def kind_of(path: str) -> str:
+    if path.startswith("test/integration/multikueue/"):
+        return "multikueue"
+    if path.startswith("test/integration/"):
+        return "integration"
+    if path.startswith("test/e2e/"):
+        return "e2e"
+    if path.startswith("test/"):
+        return "other"
+    return "unit"
+
+
+def module_root(tree: Path, rel_dir: str) -> str:
+    """Nearest directory (relative) holding go.mod, walking up from rel_dir."""
+    p = Path(rel_dir)
+    while True:
+        if (tree / p / "go.mod").is_file():
+            return "." if str(p) in ("", ".") else str(p)
+        if str(p) in ("", "."):
+            return "."
+        p = p.parent
+
+
+def module_path(tree: Path, mod_dir: str) -> str:
+    gomod = tree / mod_dir / "go.mod"
+    for line in gomod.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if gomod.is_file() else []:
+        if line.startswith("module "):
+            return line.split()[1]
+    return ""
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- plan
+
+def changed_lines(diff_u0: str) -> list[int]:
+    """New-side anchor lines from a -U0 diff (pure deletions anchor at the following line)."""
+    out = []
+    for line in diff_u0.splitlines():
+        m = HUNK_RE.match(line)
+        if not m:
+            continue
+        start, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else 1)
+        out.extend(range(start, start + count) if count else [max(start, 1)])
+    return out
+
+
+def significant(lines: list[str], anchors: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    """Drop anchors on blank lines when other anchors exist (they attach to the wrong scope)."""
+    keep = [a for a in anchors if 0 < a <= len(lines) and lines[a - 1].strip()]
+    return keep or anchors
+
+
+def go_funcs(lines: list[str]) -> list[tuple[int, int, str]]:
+    """[(start_idx, end_idx_exclusive, name)] for top-level funcs."""
+    starts = [(i, m.group(1)) for i, l in enumerate(lines) if (m := FUNC_RE.match(l))]
+    return [(s, starts[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(starts) else len(lines), n)
+            for k, (s, n) in enumerate(starts)]
+
+
+def enclosing_case(lines: list[str], func_start: int, idx: int) -> str | None:
+    """Outermost table-case name enclosing line idx (map key `"x": {` or `name: "x"` field)."""
+    cur = indent_of(lines[idx]) + 1
+    found = None
+    m = CASE_KEY_RE.match(lines[idx])
+    if m:
+        found, cur = go_unquote(m.group(1)), indent_of(lines[idx])
+    for i in range(idx - 1, func_start, -1):
+        line = lines[i]
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        ind = indent_of(line)
+        if ind >= cur:
+            continue
+        cur = ind
+        m = CASE_KEY_RE.match(line)
+        if m:
+            found = go_unquote(m.group(1))
+            continue
+        if line.strip() == "{":
+            for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 40, len(lines))):
+                if indent_of(lines[j]) <= ind and lines[j].strip():
+                    break
+                n = CASE_NAME_RE.match(lines[j])
+                if n and indent_of(lines[j]) > ind:
+                    found = go_unquote(n.group(1))
+                    break
+    return found
+
+
+def map_unit(lines: list[str], anchors: list[int]) -> list[dict]:
+    funcs = go_funcs(lines)
+    tests: dict[str, set] = {}
+    whole: set[str] = set()
+    helpers: set[str] = set()
+    for a in significant(lines, anchors):
+        idx = min(max(a - 1, 0), len(lines) - 1) if lines else 0
+        f = next(((s, e, n) for s, e, n in funcs if s <= idx < e), None)
+        if f is None:
+            continue  # package clause / imports / top-level vars
+        s, _, name = f
+        if not TEST_FUNC_RE.match(lines[s]):
+            helpers.add(name)
+            continue
+        case = enclosing_case(lines, s, idx)
+        if case is None:
+            whole.add(name)
+        tests.setdefault(name, set())
+        if case is not None:
+            tests[name].add(case)
+    for h in helpers:  # tests in this file that call a changed helper
+        pat = re.compile(r"\b" + re.escape(h) + r"\(")
+        for s, e, n in funcs:
+            if TEST_FUNC_RE.match(lines[s]) and any(pat.search(l) for l in lines[s + 1:e]):
+                tests.setdefault(n, set())
+                whole.add(n)
+    out = []
+    for name in sorted(tests):
+        out.append({"func": name, "cases": [] if name in whole else sorted(tests[name])})
+    return out
+
+
+def import_lines(lines: list[str]) -> set[int]:
+    """1-based line numbers of the package clause and import declarations."""
+    out, inside = set(), False
+    for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1):
+        t = l.strip()
+        if inside:
+            out.add(i)
+            inside = t != ")"
+        elif t.startswith("package ") or t.startswith("import "):
+            out.add(i)
+            inside = t.startswith("import (")
+    return out
+
+
+def map_ginkgo(lines: list[str], anchors: list[int]) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:
+    """Return (specs, whole_file). A spec is {leaf, containers}; leaf None = container focus.
+
+    Import-only changes are ignored. Container-only specs (setup/var changes in a
+    Describe body) that are ancestors of a changed leaf are support for that leaf
+    and do not widen the focus; they are kept as {"support": True}."""
+    specs: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
+    whole = False
+    imports = import_lines(lines)
+    for a in significant(lines, anchors):
+        if a in imports:
+            continue
+        idx = min(max(a - 1, 0), len(lines) - 1) if lines else 0
+        cur = indent_of(lines[idx]) + 1
+        leaf, containers = None, []
+        for i in range(idx, -1, -1):
+            line = lines[i]
+            if not line.strip() or (i != idx and indent_of(line) >= cur):
+                continue
+            m = GINKGO_RE.search(line)
+            if i != idx:
+                cur = indent_of(line)
+            if not m:
+                continue
+            node, text = m.group(1), go_unquote(m.group(2))
+            if node.endswith("When"):
+                text = "when " + text  # ginkgo.When prefixes its report text
+            if node in LEAF_NODES and leaf is None and not containers:
+                leaf = text
+            else:
+                containers.insert(0, text)
+            cur = indent_of(line)
+        if leaf is None and not containers:
+            whole = True
+            continue
+        key = (leaf, tuple(containers))
+        specs[key] = {"leaf": leaf, "containers": containers}
+    leaf_paths = [s["containers"] for s in specs.values() if s["leaf"]]
+    out = []
+    for s in specs.values():
+        if s["leaf"] is None and any(lp[:len(s["containers"])] == s["containers"] for lp in leaf_paths):
+            s = {**s, "support": True}
+        out.append(s)
+    return out, whole
+
+
+def build_plan(repo: str, base: str, head: str, with_support: bool = False) -> dict:
+    tree = Path(repo)
+    names = git(repo, "diff", "--no-renames", "--name-status", base, head).splitlines()
+    patch_paths, deleted, other = [], [], []
+    targets: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
+    for row in names:
+        status, path = row.split("\t", 1)
+        is_test = path.endswith("_test.go")
+        is_data = "/testdata/" in "/" + path
+        is_support = with_support and path.startswith(SUPPORT_PREFIXES) and path.endswith(".go")
+        if not (is_test or is_data or is_support):
+            other.append(path)
+            continue
+        patch_paths.append(path)
+        if is_support:
+            continue
+        if status.startswith("D"):
+            if is_test:
+                deleted.append(path)
+            continue
+        kind = kind_of(path)
+        if is_data:
+            pkg_dir = ("/" + path).split("/testdata/")[0].lstrip("/") or "."
+        else:
+            pkg_dir = str(Path(path).parent)
+        tkey = (kind, pkg_dir)
+        t = targets.setdefault(tkey, {"kind": kind, "dir": pkg_dir, "files": [], "tests": [],
+                                      "specs": [], "focus_files": [], "testdata_only": True})
+        t["files"].append(path)
+        if not is_test:
+            continue
+        t["testdata_only"] = False
+        content = git(repo, "show", f"{head}:{path}").splitlines()
+        anchors = changed_lines(git(repo, "diff", "-U0", base, head, "--", path))
+        if kind == "unit":
+            for tt in map_unit(content, anchors):
+                prev = next((x for x in t["tests"] if x["func"] == tt["func"]), None)
+                if prev is None:
+                    t["tests"].append({**tt, "file": path})
+                elif prev["cases"] and tt["cases"]:
+                    prev["cases"] = sorted(set(prev["cases"]) | set(tt["cases"]))
+                else:
+                    prev["cases"] = []
+        else:
+            specs, whole = map_ginkgo(content, anchors)
+            t["specs"].extend({**s, "file": path} for s in specs)
+            if whole or not specs:
+                t["focus_files"].append(Path(path).name)
+    out_targets = []
+    for (kind, pkg_dir), t in sorted(targets.items()):
+        if kind == "unit":
+            mod = module_root(tree, pkg_dir)
+            rel = os.path.relpath(pkg_dir, mod)
+            t["module_dir"] = mod
+            t["pkg"] = "./" + rel if rel != "." else "."
+            mp = module_path(tree, mod)
+            t["import_path"] = mp + ("/" + rel if rel != "." else "")
+        elif kind in ("e2e", "other"):
+            t["skipped"] = ("needs kind (opt-in); not run" if kind == "e2e"
+                            else "unsupported test tree; not run")
+        out_targets.append(t)
+    return {"schema": "pr-evidence.red-green.plan/v1", "base": base, "head": head,
+            "with_test_support": with_support, "patch_paths": patch_paths,
+            "deleted_tests": deleted, "non_test_files": len(other), "targets": out_targets}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- commands
+
+def unit_regex(target: dict, only: list[str] | None = None) -> str | None:
+    funcs = only if only is not None else [t["func"] for t in target["tests"]]
+    if not funcs:
+        return None
+    return "^(" + "|".join(funcs) + ")$"
+
+
+def ginkgo_focus(target: dict) -> str:
+    leaves = sorted({s["leaf"] or s["containers"][-1] for s in target["specs"]
+                     if not s.get("support")})
+    if target["focus_files"] or not leaves:
+        return " ".join("--focus-file=" + shlex.quote(f) for f in sorted(set(target["focus_files"])))
+    return "--focus=" + shlex.quote("|".join(re2_escape(l) for l in leaves))
+
+
+def command(target: dict, artifacts: str = "", only: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    if target["kind"] == "unit":
+        cmd = ["go", "test", target["pkg"], "-count=1"]
+        rx = unit_regex(target, only)
+        if rx:
+            cmd += ["-run", rx]
+        return cmd
+    filters = ginkgo_focus(target).replace("$", "$$")  # make expands $
+    if target["kind"] == "multikueue":
+        cmd = ["make", "test-multikueue-integration", f"INTEGRATION_TARGET_MULTIKUEUE=./{target['dir']}",
+               "INTEGRATION_NPROCS_MULTIKUEUE=1"]
+    else:
+        cmd = ["make", "test-integration", f"INTEGRATION_TARGET=./{target['dir']}", "INTEGRATION_NPROCS=1"]
+    cmd.append(f"INTEGRATION_FILTERS={filters}")
+    if artifacts:
+        cmd.append(f"ARTIFACTS={artifacts}")
+    return cmd
+
+
+def show_arg(a: str) -> str:
+    """Shell-quote for humans: prefer "…" over '"'"' when the value holds single quotes."""
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[\w@%+=:,./-]+", a):
+        return a
+    if "'" not in a:
+        return "'" + a + "'"
+    if not re.search(r'["$`\\!]', a):
+        return '"' + a + '"'
+    return shlex.quote(a)
+
+
+def show_cmd(args: list[str]) -> str:
+    return " ".join(show_arg(a) for a in args)
+
+
+def repro_diff(paths: list[str], base: str, head: str) -> str:
+    spec = " ".join(shlex.quote(p) for p in paths) if len(paths) <= 3 else "'*_test.go' '*/testdata/*'"
+    return f"git diff {short(base)} {short(head)} -- {spec} | git apply  # in a merge-base checkout"
+
+
+def repro(target: dict, base: str, head: str, with_support: bool) -> str:
+    spec = " ".join(shlex.quote(p) for p in target["files"]) if with_support is False and \
+        len(target["files"]) <= 2 else "'*_test.go' '*/testdata/*'"
+    cmd = command(target)
+    if target["kind"] == "unit":
+        cd = f"cd {target['module_dir']} && " if target.get("module_dir", ".") != "." else ""
+        run = cd + show_cmd(cmd)
+    else:
+        run = show_cmd(cmd)
+    return f"git diff {short(base)} {short(head)} -- {spec} | git apply  # in a merge-base checkout\n{run}"
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- parse
+
+def parse_go_json(text: str) -> dict:
+    tests: dict[str, str] = {}
+    output: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    build: list[str] = []
+    build_fail = False
+    for raw in text.splitlines():
+        try:
+            ev = json.loads(raw)
+        except ValueError:
+            build.append(raw)
+            if re.search(r"\[(build|setup) failed\]", raw):
+                build_fail = True
+            continue
+        if not isinstance(ev, dict):
+            continue
+        act, name, out = ev.get("Action"), ev.get("Test"), ev.get("Output", "")
+        if act == "build-output":
+            build.append(out.rstrip("\n"))
+        elif act == "build-fail":
+            build_fail = True
+        elif name and act in ("pass", "fail", "skip"):
+            tests[name] = act
+        elif name and act == "output":
+            output.setdefault(name, []).append(out.rstrip("\n"))
+        elif not name and act == "output":
+            if re.search(r"\[(build|setup) failed\]", out):
+                build_fail = True
+            if GO_LOC_RE.search(out) or out.startswith("# "):
+                build.append(out.rstrip("\n"))
+    if build_fail:
+        return build_failure(build)
+    return {"status": "ok", "tests": tests, "output": output, "build_error": []}
+
+
+def build_failure(lines: list[str]) -> dict:
+    """A build that failed on compiler errors is "build-fail"; anything else (disk full,
+    OOM kill, network) is an infra "error" and must not be read as "tests need new code"."""
+    infra = [l.strip() for l in lines if INFRA_RE.search(l)]
+    errs = [l.strip() for l in lines if GO_LOC_RE.search(l)]
+    if infra or not errs:
+        why = infra or [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip() and not l.startswith("# ")
+                        and not re.search(r"\[(build|setup) failed\]", l)][-4:]
+        return {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {},
+                "build_error": (why or ["build failed without a compiler error"])[:4]}
+    return {"status": "build-fail", "tests": {}, "output": {}, "build_error": errs[:8]}
+
+
+def parse_ginkgo_report(report: list, log: str = "") -> dict:
+    tests, output = {}, {}
+    setup_failed = []
+    for suite in report or []:
+        for sp in suite.get("SpecReports") or []:
+            state = sp.get("State", "")
+            if sp.get("LeafNodeType") not in LEAF_NODES:
+                if state in FAIL_STATES:
+                    setup_failed.append(f"{sp.get('LeafNodeType')}: "
+                                        f"{(sp.get('Failure') or {}).get('Message', '').splitlines()[:1]}")
+                continue
+            name = " ".join([*(sp.get("ContainerHierarchyTexts") or []), sp.get("LeafNodeText", "")]).strip()
+            st = "fail" if state in FAIL_STATES else ("pass" if state == "passed" else "skip")
+            tests[name] = st
+            if st == "fail":
+                f = sp.get("Failure") or {}
+                loc = f.get("Location") or {}
+                where = f"{Path(loc.get('FileName', '')).name}:{loc.get('LineNumber', '')}"
+                output[name] = [where + ": " + (f.get("Message") or "").splitlines()[0]] + \
+                    (f.get("Message") or "").splitlines()[1:]
+    if not tests and ("Failed to compile" in log or "build failed" in log):
+        return build_failure(log.splitlines())
+    if not tests and setup_failed:
+        return {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {}, "build_error": setup_failed[:4]}
+    return {"status": "ok" if tests or report else "error", "tests": tests, "output": output,
+            "build_error": [] if tests or report else log.splitlines()[-8:]}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- run
+
+def go_env() -> dict:
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    if sys.platform == "darwin" and "GOFLAGS" not in env:
+        env["GOFLAGS"] = "-ldflags=-linkmode=internal"  # mirrors kueue hack/make/test.mk
+    return env
+
+
+def run_target(target: dict, tree: str, art: Path, only: list[str] | None = None,
+               timeout: int = 3600) -> dict:
+    art.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    cmd = command(target, str(art), only)
+    log = art / "run.log"
+    if target["kind"] == "unit":
+        cwd = Path(tree) / target["module_dir"]
+        full = cmd + ["-json", "-timeout", "30m"]
+        try:
+            res = subprocess.run(full, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=go_env(),
+                                 timeout=timeout)
+            text = res.stdout + "\n" + res.stderr
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+            text, res = (exc.stdout or "") if isinstance(exc.stdout, str) else "", None
+        log.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
+        parsed = parse_go_json(text)
+        if res is None:
+            parsed = {**parsed, "status": "error", "build_error": ["timeout"]}
+        elif res.returncode != 0 and parsed["status"] == "ok" and not parsed["tests"]:
+            parsed = {**parsed, "status": "error",
+                      "build_error": [l for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()][-6:]}
+    else:
+        try:
+            res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=tree, capture_output=True, text=True, env=go_env(),
+                                 timeout=timeout)
+            text = res.stdout + "\n" + res.stderr
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            text = "timeout"
+        log.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
+        name = "multikueue-integration.json" if target["kind"] == "multikueue" else "integration.json"
+        rpath = art / name
+        report = json.loads(rpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if rpath.is_file() else []
+        parsed = parse_ginkgo_report(report, text)
+    if not (Path(tree) / ".git").exists():
+        parsed = {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {},
+                  "build_error": [f"worktree vanished during the run: {tree} (parallel kueue-worktree gc?)"]}
+    parsed["cmd"] = shlex.join(cmd)
+    parsed["log"] = str(log)
+    return parsed
+
+
+def apply_patch(repo: str, base: str, head: str, paths: list[str], tree: str, reverse=False) -> str:
+    if not paths:
+        return ""
+    patch = git(repo, "diff", "--binary", "--no-renames", base, head, "--", *paths)
+    args = ["git", "-C", tree, "apply", "--whitespace=nowarn"] + (["-R"] if reverse else [])
+    chk = subprocess.run(args + ["--check"], input=patch, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if chk.returncode != 0:
+        return chk.stderr.strip() or "git apply --check failed"
+    subprocess.run(args, input=patch, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+    return ""
+
+
+def existing_funcs(tree: str, target: dict) -> list[str]:
+    d = Path(tree) / target["dir"]
+    have = set()
+    for f in d.glob("*_test.go") if d.is_dir() else []:
+        have.update(m.group(1) for l in f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+                    if (m := TEST_FUNC_RE.match(l)))
+    return [t["func"] for t in target["tests"] if t["func"] in have]
+
+
+def red_rows_failed(target: dict, run: dict) -> bool:
+    return any(st == "fail" for st in run.get("tests", {}).values())
+
+
+def run_plan(plan: dict, repo: str, base_tree: str, head_tree: str, out: Path,
+             base_runs: int = BASE_RUNS, log=print) -> dict:
+    results = {"schema": "pr-evidence.red-green.results/v1", "base": plan["base"],
+               "head": plan["head"], "with_test_support": plan["with_test_support"],
+               "deleted_tests": plan["deleted_tests"], "targets": []}
+    err = apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree)
+    results["patch"] = {"paths": plan["patch_paths"], "applied": not err, "error": err}
+    for i, target in enumerate(plan["targets"]):
+        tr = {"target": target, "base_runs": [], "head_run": None, "fallback": None}
+        results["targets"].append(tr)
+        if target.get("skipped"):
+            continue
+        tag = f"{target['kind']}-{i}"
+        if not err:
+            for n in range(base_runs):
+                log(f"red-green: base run {n + 1}/{base_runs}: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+                r = run_target(target, base_tree, out / tag / f"base-{n + 1}")
+                tr["base_runs"].append(r)
+                if r["status"] != "ok" or not red_rows_failed(target, r):
+                    break
+        log(f"red-green: head run: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+        tr["head_run"] = run_target(target, head_tree, out / tag / "head")
+        base_bad = err or (tr["base_runs"] and tr["base_runs"][0]["status"] == "build-fail")
+        if base_bad:
+            only = existing_funcs(base_tree, target) if target["kind"] == "unit" else None
+            if not err:
+                apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree, reverse=True)
+            if only != []:
+                log(f"red-green: fallback: unpatched base run: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+                tr["fallback"] = {"only": only,
+                                  "run": run_target(target, base_tree, out / tag / "base-unpatched", only)}
+            else:
+                tr["fallback"] = {"only": [], "run": None}
+            if not err:
+                apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree)
+    results["rows"], results["verdict"] = evaluate(results)
+    return results
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- evaluate
+
+def leaves(tests: dict[str, str]) -> set[str]:
+    names = set(tests)
+    return {n for n in names if not any(o.startswith(n + "/") for o in names)}
+
+
+def side(run: dict | None, names: list[str]) -> str:
+    if run is None:
+        return "none"
+    if run["status"] == "build-fail":
+        return "build-fail"
+    if run["status"] != "ok":
+        return "error"
+    sts = [run["tests"].get(n) for n in names]
+    if not names or all(s is None for s in sts):
+        return "missing"
+    if any(s == "fail" for s in sts):
+        return "fail"
+    return "pass"
+
+
+def first_failure(run: dict | None, names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    for n in names:
+        if run and run.get("tests", {}).get(n) == "fail":
+            lines = [l.expandtabs(4).rstrip() for l in run.get("output", {}).get(n, [])
+                     if l.strip() and not re.match(r"^\s*(===|---) ", l)
+                     and not KLOG_RE.match(l.strip())]
+            for pat in (TEST_LOC_RE, re.compile(r"\.go:\d+")):
+                k = next((k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.search(l)), None)
+                if k is not None:
+                    return dedent(lines[k:k + 20])
+            return dedent(lines[:20])
+    return []
+
+
+def dedent(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Strip the common indent so cmp diffs keep their shape; first line fully stripped."""
+    if not lines:
+        return lines
+    ind = min(len(l) - len(l.lstrip()) for l in lines)
+    return [lines[0].strip()] + [l[ind:] for l in lines[1:]]
+
+
+def row_groups(tr: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]]:
+    """[(label, junit_key, leaf_names)] from the head run (falls back to base run names)."""
+    t = tr["target"]
+    ref = tr["head_run"] if tr["head_run"] and tr["head_run"]["status"] == "ok" else \
+        next((r for r in tr["base_runs"] if r["status"] == "ok"), None)
+    names = leaves(ref["tests"]) if ref else set()
+    groups = []
+    if t["kind"] == "unit":
+        if not t["tests"]:  # testdata only: every top-level test that changed outcome
+            tops = sorted({n.split("/")[0] for n in names})
+            return [(f"`{f}`", f, sorted(n for n in names if n == f or n.startswith(f + "/")))
+                    for f in tops]
+        for tt in t["tests"]:
+            f = tt["func"]
+            under = sorted(n for n in names if n == f or n.startswith(f + "/"))
+            if not tt["cases"]:
+                groups.append((f"`{f}`", f, under or [f]))
+                continue
+            covered = set()
+            for c in tt["cases"]:
+                pref = f + "/" + go_subtest_name(c)
+                m = sorted(n for n in under if n == pref or n.startswith(pref))
+                covered.update(m)
+                groups.append((f"`{f}` › {c}", pref, m or [pref]))
+            rest = [n for n in under if n not in covered]
+            if rest:
+                groups.append((f"`{f}` (other subtests)", "", rest))
+    else:
+        wanted = [s for s in t["specs"] if s["leaf"]]
+        for n in sorted(names):
+            if ref["tests"][n] == "skip":
+                continue
+            if wanted and not t["focus_files"] and not any(n.endswith(s["leaf"]) for s in wanted):
+                continue
+            spec = next((s for s in wanted if n.endswith(s["leaf"])), None)
+            label = n if spec is None or not spec["containers"] else \
+                f"{spec['containers'][0]} › {spec['leaf']}"
+            groups.append((label, n, [n]))
+        if not groups:
+            groups = [(" ".join([*s["containers"], s["leaf"] or ""]).strip(),
+                       s["leaf"] or s["containers"][-1], [" ".join([*s["containers"], s["leaf"] or ""]).strip()])
+                      for s in t["specs"] if not s.get("support")]
+    return groups
+
+
+def evaluate(results: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
+    rows = []
+    counts = {"red_green": 0, "green_both": 0, "flaky": 0, "head_fail": 0, "na": 0, "new": 0,
+              "error": 0}
+    runners, na_reason, err_reason, skipped = set(), "", "", []
+    for tr in results["targets"]:
+        t = tr["target"]
+        if t.get("skipped"):
+            skipped.append(f"{t['kind']} `{t['dir']}`: {t['skipped']}")
+            continue
+        runners.add("unit (`go test`)" if t["kind"] == "unit" else
+                    "envtest (MultiKueue)" if t["kind"] == "multikueue" else "envtest")
+        base_na = not results["patch"]["applied"] or \
+            (tr["base_runs"] and tr["base_runs"][0]["status"] == "build-fail")
+        if base_na and not na_reason:
+            be = tr["base_runs"][0]["build_error"] if tr["base_runs"] else []
+            na_reason = results["patch"]["error"] or (be[0] if be else "build failed")
+        for r in [*tr["base_runs"], tr["head_run"]]:
+            if r and r["status"] == "error" and not err_reason:

+        for label, jkey, names in row_groups(tr):
+            other = label.endswith("(other subtests)")
+            head = side(tr["head_run"], names)
+            row = {"test": label, "junit_key": jkey, "kind": t["kind"],
+                   "import_path": t.get("import_path", ""), "leaves": len(names), "other": other,
+                   "head": head}
+            if base_na:
+                fb = tr.get("fallback") or {}
+                fr = fb.get("run")

+                         sorted(n for n in (fr or {}).get("tests", {}) if n == func or n.startswith(func + "/")))
+                row.update(base="na", base_unpatched=b if exists else "new")
+                counts["na"] += 1
+            else:
+                sides = [side(r, names) for r in tr["base_runs"]]
+                fails = sum(s == "fail" for s in sides)
+                row.update(base_fails=fails, base_runs=len(sides),
+                           base="error" if sides and all(s == "error" for s in sides) else
+                           "red" if sides and fails == len(sides) else "flaky" if fails else "green")
+                row["excerpt"] = first_failure(tr["base_runs"][0], names) if fails else []
+                if not other:
+                    if head == "error" or row["base"] == "error":
+                        counts["error"] += 1
+                    elif head != "pass":
+                        counts["head_fail"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "red":
+                        counts["red_green"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "flaky":
+                        counts["flaky"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "green":
+                        counts["green_both"] += 1
+            row["cmd"] = repro(t, results["base"], results["head"], results["with_test_support"])
+            rows.append(row)
+    main = [r for r in rows if not r["other"]]
+    if not main and not skipped:
+        verdict = ("none", "no new or changed Go tests in this PR")
+    elif counts["head_fail"]:
+        verdict = ("red", f"{counts['head_fail']} changed test(s) fail on head — fix before publishing")
+    elif counts["error"]:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"run errored, not a test result ({cell_text(err_reason, 120)}) "
+                           f"— fix the environment and re-run before publishing")
+    elif counts["na"]:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"not applicable: tests depend on new code ({na_reason})")
+    elif main and counts["red_green"] == len(main):
+        verdict = ("green", f"red→green: {len(main)}/{len(main)} changed tests fail on the merge base "

+    elif counts["red_green"]:

+    elif main:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"no red on base: {counts['green_both']} pass on base too, "
+                           f"{counts['flaky']} flaky (tests do not prove the fix)")
+    else:
+        verdict = ("warn", "changed tests need kind; not run")
+    return rows, {"level": verdict[0], "text": verdict[1], "runners": sorted(runners),
+                  "skipped": skipped, "counts": counts}

+JOB_PATTERNS = {

  **Follow `nextPageToken` when listing Prow artifacts.**
  
  The GCS artifact listing at lines 906-907 reads one page of `objects.list` and ignores `nextPageToken`. A job whose `artifacts/` prefix holds more objects than one page can hide its changed-test JUnit files. `prow_line` then omits that job or shows it without JUnit counts. Request each page until the token is empty.

+    res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=timeout)
+    if check and res.returncode != 0:
+        raise Fail(f"{shlex.join(cmd)} failed ({res.returncode}): {res.stderr.strip()[:500]}")
+    return res

+    """Escape for Go RE2 (it rejects escaped letters/spaces, so only escape metacharacters)."""
+    return re.sub(r"([\\.+*?()|\[\]{}^$])", r"\\\1", text)

+        elif c == " ":

+    if path.startswith("test/integration/"):
+        return "integration"
+    if path.startswith("test/e2e/"):

+    if path.startswith("test/"):

+    return "unit"

+def module_root(tree: Path, rel_dir: str) -> str:
+    """Nearest directory (relative) holding go.mod, walking up from rel_dir."""
+    p = Path(rel_dir)

+        if line.startswith("module "):

+def changed_lines(diff_u0: str) -> list[int]:

+    out = []

+    keep = [a for a in anchors if 0 < a <= len(lines) and lines[a - 1].strip()]

+    """Outermost table-case name enclosing line idx (map key `"x": {` or `name: "x"` field)."""
+    cur = indent_of(lines[idx]) + 1
+    found = None

+        m = CASE_KEY_RE.match(line)

+    funcs = go_funcs(lines)

+    whole: set[str] = set()

+        if f is None:
+            continue  # package clause / imports / top-level vars

+        if not TEST_FUNC_RE.match(lines[s]):

+            whole.add(name)

+    out, inside = set(), False
+    for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1):

+        if inside:

+            inside = t != ")"
+        elif t.startswith("package ") or t.startswith("import "):

+def map_ginkgo(lines: list[str], anchors: list[int]) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:
+    """Return (specs, whole_file). A spec is {leaf, containers}; leaf None = container focus.
+
+    Import-only changes are ignored. Container-only specs (setup/var changes in a

+    and do not widen the focus; they are kept as {"support": True}."""

+        cur = indent_of(lines[idx]) + 1

+            line = lines[i]
+            if not line.strip() or (i != idx and indent_of(line) >= cur):

+            if i != idx:

+            if not m:

+            if node.endswith("When"):

+            if node in LEAF_NODES and leaf is None and not containers:
+                leaf = text
+            else:

+        out.append(s)

+def build_plan(repo: str, base: str, head: str, with_support: bool = False) -> dict:

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- commands
+
+def unit_regex(target: dict, only: list[str] | None = None) -> str | None:
+    funcs = only if only is not None else [t["func"] for t in target["tests"]]
+    if not funcs:
+        return None
+    return "^(" + "|".join(funcs) + ")$"

+def ginkgo_focus(target: dict) -> str:
+    leaves = sorted({s["leaf"] or s["containers"][-1] for s in target["specs"]
+                     if not s.get("support")})

+        return " ".join("--focus-file=" + shlex.quote(f) for f in sorted(set(target["focus_files"])))
+    return "--focus=" + shlex.quote("|".join(re2_escape(l) for l in leaves))

+    if target["kind"] == "multikueue":

+    if re.fullmatch(r"[\w@%+=:,./-]+", a):

+    return shlex.quote(a)

+def show_cmd(args: list[str]) -> str:
+    return " ".join(show_arg(a) for a in args)

+def repro_diff(paths: list[str], base: str, head: str) -> str:
+    spec = " ".join(shlex.quote(p) for p in paths) if len(paths) <= 3 else "'*_test.go' '*/testdata/*'"

+        len(target["files"]) <= 2 else "'*_test.go' '*/testdata/*'"

+        cd = f"cd {target['module_dir']} && " if target.get("module_dir", ".") != "." else ""
+        run = cd + show_cmd(cmd)
+    else:
+        run = show_cmd(cmd)
+    return f"git diff {short(base)} {short(head)} -- {spec} | git apply  # in a merge-base checkout\n{run}"

+def parse_go_json(text: str) -> dict:
+    tests: dict[str, str] = {}
+    output: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    build: list[str] = []
+    build_fail = False
+    for raw in text.splitlines():

+            ev = json.loads(raw)
+        except ValueError:

+                build_fail = True

+        elif act == "build-fail":
+            build_fail = True
+        elif name and act in ("pass", "fail", "skip"):

+def build_failure(lines: list[str]) -> dict:
+    """A build that failed on compiler errors is "build-fail"; anything else (disk full,
+    OOM kill, network) is an infra "error" and must not be read as "tests need new code"."""
+    infra = [l.strip() for l in lines if INFRA_RE.search(l)]
+    errs = [l.strip() for l in lines if GO_LOC_RE.search(l)]
+    if infra or not errs:
+        why = infra or [l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip() and not l.startswith("# ")
+                        and not re.search(r"\[(build|setup) failed\]", l)][-4:]
+        return {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {},
+                "build_error": (why or ["build failed without a compiler error"])[:4]}
+    return {"status": "build-fail", "tests": {}, "output": {}, "build_error": errs[:8]}
+
+
+def parse_ginkgo_report(report: list, log: str = "") -> dict:
+    tests, output = {}, {}
+    setup_failed = []
+    for suite in report or []:
+        for sp in suite.get("SpecReports") or []:
+            state = sp.get("State", "")
+            if sp.get("LeafNodeType") not in LEAF_NODES:
+                if state in FAIL_STATES:
+                    setup_failed.append(f"{sp.get('LeafNodeType')}: "
+                                        f"{(sp.get('Failure') or {}).get('Message', '').splitlines()[:1]}")
+                continue
+            name = " ".join([*(sp.get("ContainerHierarchyTexts") or []), sp.get("LeafNodeText", "")]).strip()
+            st = "fail" if state in FAIL_STATES else ("pass" if state == "passed" else "skip")
+            tests[name] = st
+            if st == "fail":
+                f = sp.get("Failure") or {}
+                loc = f.get("Location") or {}
+                where = f"{Path(loc.get('FileName', '')).name}:{loc.get('LineNumber', '')}"
+                output[name] = [where + ": " + (f.get("Message") or "").splitlines()[0]] + \
+                    (f.get("Message") or "").splitlines()[1:]
+    if not tests and ("Failed to compile" in log or "build failed" in log):
+        return build_failure(log.splitlines())
+    if not tests and setup_failed:
+        return {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {}, "build_error": setup_failed[:4]}
+    return {"status": "ok" if tests or report else "error", "tests": tests, "output": output,
+            "build_error": [] if tests or report else log.splitlines()[-8:]}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- run
+
+def go_env() -> dict:
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    if sys.platform == "darwin" and "GOFLAGS" not in env:
+        env["GOFLAGS"] = "-ldflags=-linkmode=internal"  # mirrors kueue hack/make/test.mk
+    return env
+
+
+def run_target(target: dict, tree: str, art: Path, only: list[str] | None = None,
+               timeout: int = 3600) -> dict:
+    art.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    cmd = command(target, str(art), only)
+    log = art / "run.log"
+    if target["kind"] == "unit":
+        cwd = Path(tree) / target["module_dir"]
+        full = cmd + ["-json", "-timeout", "30m"]
+        try:
+            res = subprocess.run(full, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=go_env(),
+                                 timeout=timeout)
+            text = res.stdout + "\n" + res.stderr
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+            text, res = (exc.stdout or "") if isinstance(exc.stdout, str) else "", None
+        log.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
+        parsed = parse_go_json(text)
+        if res is None:
+            parsed = {**parsed, "status": "error", "build_error": ["timeout"]}
+        elif res.returncode != 0 and parsed["status"] == "ok" and not parsed["tests"]:
+            parsed = {**parsed, "status": "error",
+                      "build_error": [l for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()][-6:]}
+    else:
+        try:
+            res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=tree, capture_output=True, text=True, env=go_env(),
+                                 timeout=timeout)
+            text = res.stdout + "\n" + res.stderr
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            text = "timeout"
+        log.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
+        name = "multikueue-integration.json" if target["kind"] == "multikueue" else "integration.json"
+        rpath = art / name
+        report = json.loads(rpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if rpath.is_file() else []
+        parsed = parse_ginkgo_report(report, text)
+    if not (Path(tree) / ".git").exists():
+        parsed = {"status": "error", "tests": {}, "output": {},
+                  "build_error": [f"worktree vanished during the run: {tree} (parallel kueue-worktree gc?)"]}
+    parsed["cmd"] = shlex.join(cmd)
+    parsed["log"] = str(log)
+    return parsed
+
+
+def apply_patch(repo: str, base: str, head: str, paths: list[str], tree: str, reverse=False) -> str:
+    if not paths:
+        return ""
+    patch = git(repo, "diff", "--binary", "--no-renames", base, head, "--", *paths)
+    args = ["git", "-C", tree, "apply", "--whitespace=nowarn"] + (["-R"] if reverse else [])
+    chk = subprocess.run(args + ["--check"], input=patch, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if chk.returncode != 0:
+        return chk.stderr.strip() or "git apply --check failed"
+    subprocess.run(args, input=patch, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+    return ""
+
+
+def existing_funcs(tree: str, target: dict) -> list[str]:
+    d = Path(tree) / target["dir"]
+    have = set()
+    for f in d.glob("*_test.go") if d.is_dir() else []:
+        have.update(m.group(1) for l in f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+                    if (m := TEST_FUNC_RE.match(l)))
+    return [t["func"] for t in target["tests"] if t["func"] in have]
+
+
+def red_rows_failed(target: dict, run: dict) -> bool:
+    return any(st == "fail" for st in run.get("tests", {}).values())
+
+
+def run_plan(plan: dict, repo: str, base_tree: str, head_tree: str, out: Path,
+             base_runs: int = BASE_RUNS, log=print) -> dict:
+    results = {"schema": "pr-evidence.red-green.results/v1", "base": plan["base"],
+               "head": plan["head"], "with_test_support": plan["with_test_support"],
+               "deleted_tests": plan["deleted_tests"], "targets": []}
+    err = apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree)
+    results["patch"] = {"paths": plan["patch_paths"], "applied": not err, "error": err}
+    for i, target in enumerate(plan["targets"]):
+        tr = {"target": target, "base_runs": [], "head_run": None, "fallback": None}
+        results["targets"].append(tr)
+        if target.get("skipped"):
+            continue
+        tag = f"{target['kind']}-{i}"
+        if not err:
+            for n in range(base_runs):
+                log(f"red-green: base run {n + 1}/{base_runs}: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+                r = run_target(target, base_tree, out / tag / f"base-{n + 1}")
+                tr["base_runs"].append(r)
+                if r["status"] != "ok" or not red_rows_failed(target, r):
+                    break
+        log(f"red-green: head run: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+        tr["head_run"] = run_target(target, head_tree, out / tag / "head")
+        base_bad = err or (tr["base_runs"] and tr["base_runs"][0]["status"] == "build-fail")
+        if base_bad:
+            only = existing_funcs(base_tree, target) if target["kind"] == "unit" else None
+            if not err:
+                apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree, reverse=True)
+            if only != []:
+                log(f"red-green: fallback: unpatched base run: {target['kind']} {target['dir']}")
+                tr["fallback"] = {"only": only,
+                                  "run": run_target(target, base_tree, out / tag / "base-unpatched", only)}
+            else:
+                tr["fallback"] = {"only": [], "run": None}
+            if not err:
+                apply_patch(repo, plan["base"], plan["head"], plan["patch_paths"], base_tree)
+    results["rows"], results["verdict"] = evaluate(results)
+    return results
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- evaluate
+
+def leaves(tests: dict[str, str]) -> set[str]:
+    names = set(tests)
+    return {n for n in names if not any(o.startswith(n + "/") for o in names)}
+
+
+def side(run: dict | None, names: list[str]) -> str:
+    if run is None:
+        return "none"
+    if run["status"] == "build-fail":
+        return "build-fail"
+    if run["status"] != "ok":
+        return "error"
+    sts = [run["tests"].get(n) for n in names]
+    if not names or all(s is None for s in sts):
+        return "missing"
+    if any(s == "fail" for s in sts):
+        return "fail"
+    return "pass"
+
+
+def first_failure(run: dict | None, names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    for n in names:
+        if run and run.get("tests", {}).get(n) == "fail":
+            lines = [l.expandtabs(4).rstrip() for l in run.get("output", {}).get(n, [])
+                     if l.strip() and not re.match(r"^\s*(===|---) ", l)
+                     and not KLOG_RE.match(l.strip())]
+            for pat in (TEST_LOC_RE, re.compile(r"\.go:\d+")):
+                k = next((k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.search(l)), None)
+                if k is not None:
+                    return dedent(lines[k:k + 20])
+            return dedent(lines[:20])
+    return []
+
+
+def dedent(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Strip the common indent so cmp diffs keep their shape; first line fully stripped."""
+    if not lines:
+        return lines
+    ind = min(len(l) - len(l.lstrip()) for l in lines)
+    return [lines[0].strip()] + [l[ind:] for l in lines[1:]]
+
+
+def row_groups(tr: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]]:
+    """[(label, junit_key, leaf_names)] from the head run (falls back to base run names)."""
+    t = tr["target"]
+    ref = tr["head_run"] if tr["head_run"] and tr["head_run"]["status"] == "ok" else \
+        next((r for r in tr["base_runs"] if r["status"] == "ok"), None)
+    names = leaves(ref["tests"]) if ref else set()
+    groups = []
+    if t["kind"] == "unit":
+        if not t["tests"]:  # testdata only: every top-level test that changed outcome
+            tops = sorted({n.split("/")[0] for n in names})
+            return [(f"`{f}`", f, sorted(n for n in names if n == f or n.startswith(f + "/")))
+                    for f in tops]
+        for tt in t["tests"]:
+            f = tt["func"]
+            under = sorted(n for n in names if n == f or n.startswith(f + "/"))
+            if not tt["cases"]:
+                groups.append((f"`{f}`", f, under or [f]))
+                continue
+            covered = set()
+            for c in tt["cases"]:
+                pref = f + "/" + go_subtest_name(c)
+                m = sorted(n for n in under if n == pref or n.startswith(pref))
+                covered.update(m)
+                groups.append((f"`{f}` › {c}", pref, m or [pref]))
+            rest = [n for n in under if n not in covered]
+            if rest:
+                groups.append((f"`{f}` (other subtests)", "", rest))
+    else:
+        wanted = [s for s in t["specs"] if s["leaf"]]
+        for n in sorted(names):
+            if ref["tests"][n] == "skip":
+                continue
+            if wanted and not t["focus_files"] and not any(n.endswith(s["leaf"]) for s in wanted):
+                continue
+            spec = next((s for s in wanted if n.endswith(s["leaf"])), None)
+            label = n if spec is None or not spec["containers"] else \
+                f"{spec['containers'][0]} › {spec['leaf']}"
+            groups.append((label, n, [n]))
+        if not groups:
+            groups = [(" ".join([*s["containers"], s["leaf"] or ""]).strip(),
+                       s["leaf"] or s["containers"][-1], [" ".join([*s["containers"], s["leaf"] or ""]).strip()])
+                      for s in t["specs"] if not s.get("support")]
+    return groups
+
+
+def evaluate(results: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
+    rows = []
+    counts = {"red_green": 0, "green_both": 0, "flaky": 0, "head_fail": 0, "na": 0, "new": 0,
+              "error": 0}
+    runners, na_reason, err_reason, skipped = set(), "", "", []
+    for tr in results["targets"]:
+        t = tr["target"]
+        if t.get("skipped"):
+            skipped.append(f"{t['kind']} `{t['dir']}`: {t['skipped']}")
+            continue
+        runners.add("unit (`go test`)" if t["kind"] == "unit" else
+                    "envtest (MultiKueue)" if t["kind"] == "multikueue" else "envtest")
+        base_na = not results["patch"]["applied"] or \
+            (tr["base_runs"] and tr["base_runs"][0]["status"] == "build-fail")
+        if base_na and not na_reason:
+            be = tr["base_runs"][0]["build_error"] if tr["base_runs"] else []
+            na_reason = results["patch"]["error"] or (be[0] if be else "build failed")
+        for r in [*tr["base_runs"], tr["head_run"]]:
+            if r and r["status"] == "error" and not err_reason:
+                err_reason = (r.get("build_error") or ["run failed"])[0]
+        for label, jkey, names in row_groups(tr):
+            other = label.endswith("(other subtests)")
+            head = side(tr["head_run"], names)
+            row = {"test": label, "junit_key": jkey, "kind": t["kind"],
+                   "import_path": t.get("import_path", ""), "leaves": len(names), "other": other,
+                   "head": head}
+            if base_na:
+                fb = tr.get("fallback") or {}
+                fr = fb.get("run")
+                func = jkey.split("/")[0]
+                exists = t["kind"] != "unit" or func in (fb.get("only") or [])
+                b = side(fr, names if not exists or t["kind"] != "unit" else
+                         sorted(n for n in (fr or {}).get("tests", {}) if n == func or n.startswith(func + "/")))
+                row.update(base="na", base_unpatched=b if exists else "new")
+                counts["na"] += 1
+            else:
+                sides = [side(r, names) for r in tr["base_runs"]]
+                fails = sum(s == "fail" for s in sides)
+                row.update(base_fails=fails, base_runs=len(sides),
+                           base="error" if sides and all(s == "error" for s in sides) else
+                           "red" if sides and fails == len(sides) else "flaky" if fails else "green")
+                row["excerpt"] = first_failure(tr["base_runs"][0], names) if fails else []
+                if not other:
+                    if head == "error" or row["base"] == "error":
+                        counts["error"] += 1
+                    elif head != "pass":
+                        counts["head_fail"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "red":
+                        counts["red_green"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "flaky":
+                        counts["flaky"] += 1
+                    elif row["base"] == "green":
+                        counts["green_both"] += 1
+            row["cmd"] = repro(t, results["base"], results["head"], results["with_test_support"])
+            rows.append(row)
+    main = [r for r in rows if not r["other"]]
+    if not main and not skipped:
+        verdict = ("none", "no new or changed Go tests in this PR")
+    elif counts["head_fail"]:
+        verdict = ("red", f"{counts['head_fail']} changed test(s) fail on head — fix before publishing")
+    elif counts["error"]:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"run errored, not a test result ({cell_text(err_reason, 120)}) "
+                           f"— fix the environment and re-run before publishing")
+    elif counts["na"]:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"not applicable: tests depend on new code ({na_reason})")
+    elif main and counts["red_green"] == len(main):
+        verdict = ("green", f"red→green: {len(main)}/{len(main)} changed tests fail on the merge base "
+                            f"(consistently) and pass on head")
+    elif counts["red_green"]:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"partial: {counts['red_green']}/{len(main)} red→green; "
+                           f"{counts['green_both']} pass on base too, {counts['flaky']} flaky on base")
+    elif main:
+        verdict = ("warn", f"no red on base: {counts['green_both']} pass on base too, "
+                           f"{counts['flaky']} flaky (tests do not prove the fix)")
+    else:
+        verdict = ("warn", "changed tests need kind; not run")
+    return rows, {"level": verdict[0], "text": verdict[1], "runners": sorted(runners),
+                  "skipped": skipped, "counts": counts}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- prow
+
+JOB_PATTERNS = {
+    "unit": re.compile(r"^pull-kueue-test-unit"),
+    "integration": re.compile(r"^pull-kueue-test-integration-(?!multikueue)"),
+    "multikueue": re.compile(r"^pull-kueue-test-integration-multikueue"),
+    "e2e": re.compile(r"^pull-kueue-test-e2e"),
+}
+GCS_API = "https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o"
+GCS_RAW = "https://storage.googleapis.com/{bucket}/{obj}"
+
+
+def gh_json(*args: str):
+    try:
+        res = subprocess.run(["gh", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+        raise Fail("gh CLI not found on PATH") from exc
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
+        raise Fail(f"gh {' '.join(args[:2])} failed: {exc.stderr.strip()[:300]}") from exc
+    return json.loads(res.stdout or "null")
+
+
+def http_get(url: str, limit: int = 64 << 20) -> bytes:
+    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "kueue-pr-evidence-red-green"})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:  # noqa: S310 (fixed https hosts)
+        return resp.read(limit)
+
+
+def job_patterns(target: dict) -> re.Pattern:
+    mod = target.get("module_dir", ".")
+    if mod != ".":  # nested module, e.g. cmd/experimental/kueue-populator
+        return re.compile(r"^pull-" + re.escape(Path(mod).name) + r"-test-(unit|integration)")
+    return JOB_PATTERNS.get(target["kind"], re.compile(r"^$"))
+
+
+def statuses_for(sha: str, repo: str, pr: str | None) -> list[dict]:
+    data = gh_json("api", f"repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/status?per_page=100")
+    sts = [{"context": s["context"], "state": s["state"], "url": s.get("target_url") or ""}
+           for s in (data or {}).get("statuses", [])]
+    if not any("prow.k8s.io" in s["url"] for s in sts) and pr:
+        pv = gh_json("pr", "view", pr, "--repo", repo, "--json", "headRefOid,statusCheckRollup")
+        if (pv.get("headRefOid") or "").startswith(sha):
+            sts = [{"context": c.get("context") or c.get("name", ""),
+                    "state": (c.get("state") or c.get("conclusion") or c.get("status") or "").lower(),
+                    "url": c.get("targetUrl") or c.get("detailsUrl") or ""}
+                   for c in pv.get("statusCheckRollup") or []]
+    return sts
+
+
+def gcs_parts(url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    m = re.match(r"^https://prow\.k8s\.io/view/gs/([^/]+)/(.+?)/?$", url)
+    return (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else None
+
+
+def junit_cases(xml_bytes: bytes):
+    root = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
+    for tc in root.iter("testcase"):
+        failed = tc.find("failure") is not None or tc.find("error") is not None
+        skipped = tc.find("skipped") is not None
+        yield tc.get("classname", ""), tc.get("name", ""), "fail" if failed else "skip" if skipped else "pass"
+
+
+def match_junit(rows: list[dict], cases) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    hits: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    for cls, name, st in cases:
+        for r in rows:
+            key = r["junit_key"]
+            if not key or r["other"]:
+                continue
+            if r["kind"] == "unit":
+                ok = (not r["import_path"] or cls == r["import_path"]) and \
+                    (name == key or name.startswith(key + "/") or ("/" in key and name.startswith(key)))
+            else:
+                ok = key in name
+            if ok:
+                h = hits.setdefault(r["test"], {"pass": 0, "fail": 0, "skip": 0})
+                h[st] += 1
+    return hits
+
+
+def prow_lookup(results: dict, pr: str | None, repo: str = DEFAULT_REPO,
+                fetch_junit: bool = True, statuses: list[dict] | None = None,
+                fetch=http_get) -> dict:
+    sha = results["head"]
+    sts = statuses if statuses is not None else statuses_for(sha, repo, pr)
+    prow = [s for s in sts if "prow.k8s.io/view/" in s["url"]]
+    kinds = [tr["target"] for tr in results["targets"]]
+    rows = results.get("rows", [])
+    jobs = []
+    for s in prow:
+        if not any(job_patterns(t).match(s["context"]) for t in kinds):
+            continue
+        parts = gcs_parts(s["url"])
+        jkinds = sorted({t["kind"] for t in kinds if job_patterns(t).match(s["context"])})
+        jrows = [r for r in rows if r["kind"] in jkinds]
+        job = {"context": s["context"], "state": s["state"], "url": s["url"], "kinds": jkinds,
+               "build": s["url"].rstrip("/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1], "junit": [], "hits": {},
+               "revision_ok": None}
+        if fetch_junit and parts and s["state"] in ("success", "failure", "error"):
+            bucket, prefix = parts
+            try:
+                fin = json.loads(fetch(GCS_RAW.format(bucket=bucket, obj=prefix + "/finished.json")))
+                job["revision_ok"] = (fin.get("revision") or "").startswith(sha[:12]) or None
+                q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"prefix": prefix + "/artifacts/", "fields": "items(name)"})
+                items = json.loads(fetch(GCS_API.format(bucket=bucket) + "?" + q)).get("items", [])
+                for it in items:
+                    if re.search(r"/junit[^/]*\.xml$", it["name"]):
+                        job["junit"].append(it["name"].split("/artifacts/", 1)[1])
+                        hits = match_junit(jrows, junit_cases(fetch(GCS_RAW.format(bucket=bucket,
+                                                                                 obj=it["name"]))))
+                        for k, v in hits.items():
+                            agg = job["hits"].setdefault(k, {"pass": 0, "fail": 0, "skip": 0})
+                            for kk in v:
+                                agg[kk] += v[kk]
+            except (urllib.error.URLError, ValueError, ET.ParseError, OSError) as exc:
+                job["junit_error"] = str(exc)[:200]
+        jobs.append(job)
+    pending = [j for j in jobs if j["state"] == "pending"]
+    return {"schema": "pr-evidence.red-green.prow/v1", "sha": sha, "jobs": jobs,
+            "pending": bool(pending), "found": bool(prow)}
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- render
+
+def visible_lines(text: str) -> int:
+    depth = count = 0
+    for line in text.split("\n"):
+        opens = len(re.findall(r"<details\b", line, re.IGNORECASE))
+        closes = len(re.findall(r"</details\s*>", line, re.IGNORECASE))
+        if depth == 0 and line.strip():
+            count += 1
+        depth = max(0, depth + opens - closes)
+    return count
+
+
+def scrub_path(line: str) -> str:
+    """Make local worktree paths repo-relative and hide the home directory."""
+    line = TREE_PATH_RE.sub("", line)
+    home = str(Path.home())
+    return line.replace(home + "/", "~/") if home not in ("", "/") else line
+
+
